name: slurp-backend
description: Self-hosted Slurp ingest and archive Worker for Cloudflare (Durable Objects + R2).

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Secret bearer token that controls this deployment. Make it long and random (openssl rand -base64 32). After the deploy, run `slurp connect <your Worker URL> --token-stdin` and give it this token.

ARCHIVE.description: R2 bucket that stores your sealed event archives.
